name: Ramadan Countdown
author: Amdadul Haq

sections.description:
Display Ramadan Countdown and daily Seheri & Iftar timetable for all divisions of Bangladesh. Easy to use via widgets or shortcodes.

Shortcodes:

[rdcd_countdown] — Countdown for Dhaka division.

[rdcd_timetable] — Full timetable for all divisions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ramadan-countdown/, or install directly from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Appearance → Widgets to add a widget, or use [rdcd_countdown] / [rdcd_timetable] shortcodes anywhere.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It displays a live countdown to Seheri/Iftar for Dhaka and a full daily timetable for all divisions of Bangladesh during Ramadan.

How do I use it?

Go to Appearance → Widgets and add the “কাউন্টডাউন উইজেট” or “টাইমটেবিল উইজেট” widget to your sidebar. Alternatively, use the shortcodes [rdcd_countdown] or [rdcd_timetable] in any post, page, or block editor.

Which divisions are covered?

All 8 divisions of Bangladesh: Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barisal, Sylhet, Rangpur, and Mymensingh.

Does it update automatically?

Yes. The timetable and countdown data are fetched live from the server, so times are always accurate for the current Ramadan.
